scope.description: Qualify Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation as a new Canadian company candidate and deeply map its nuclear-energy, lunar-resource, water-purification, portable-imaging and quantum-sensing portfolio using complementary official evidence.

source.title: Canadian Strategic Missions Corporation official portfolio
source.locator: Who we are, Nuclear, LEUNR, Labs, Team, Partner With Us and Contact sections
source.summary: CSMC describes a Canadian space and defence company with wholly owned CSMC Nuclear and CSMC Labs divisions, a development-stage LEUNR microreactor, and research depth spanning quantum, robotics, nanomaterials, electrochemistry, industrial automation and space systems.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official company portfolio and rebrand; federal name record; current FedDev, DND, NRC and CSA funding, challenge, contract and project sources
followUpQuestions: Confirm whether Waterloo or Toronto should be treated as the current primary headquarters; July 2026 FedDev reporting calls CSMC Waterloo-based while CSA and other official records retain Toronto locations.
Confirm the current regulatory and licensing pathway for LEUNR before representing any schedule beyond the company's stated 2029 demonstration target.
reviewWarnings: LEUNR remains a development-stage reactor program; government sources document prototype work and funding, not a licensed or deployed commercial reactor.
The QASM contract and technical description are sourced to a company-issued announcement; an independent Luxembourg Space Agency project page was not resolved.

Current official sources differ on whether Waterloo or Toronto is the primary headquarters; Waterloo is used as the map location because the newest FedDev Ontario profile calls the company Waterloo-based.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Official material established the current identity, subsidiaries, leadership, LEUNR and Labs research scope.
Current FedDev reporting independently confirmed identity, name continuity, Waterloo presence, microreactor purpose, project cost and contribution.
CSA and DND program records supported LunaPure, HYDRO+, LEUNR, lunar studies and defence innovation participation.
CanadaBuys corroborated a competitively awarded CSA research contract under the former name and CSMC operating identity.
The CIPO record resolved the formal name transition and the nuclear, quantum, aerospace and geophysical technology scope.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Official company and government sources establish a Canadian space and defence technology developer incorporated in 2020, operating through CSMC Nuclear and CSMC Labs, with concrete programs in portable micro-nuclear power, lunar water purification and resource processing, portable multi-sensor imaging, and space-based quantum sensing. Current federal evidence ties its work to Arctic defence, NORAD modernization, remote energy and lunar infrastructure.
